label: lives or has lived in
definition: Person X lives or has lived in geographic location Y.
scope_notes: This highly mixed dictionary was inspected together with all 32 relation facts before selection. Its largest recurring place-oriented family comprises obituary-style personal-name/of-city paths and explicit home/live-in paths; the directional residence criterion is retained without merging it with workplace location. Explicit residence/home qualifies. Bare son/brother apposition to a city needs attachment review; professional practice, company location, generic presence and organizational leadership alone are different predicates.
